title: Choose useful cases
summary: A test case includes inputs and the expected result. Choose cases that exercise different rules.
introduction: A test case includes inputs and the expected result. Choose cases that exercise different rules. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A test case includes inputs and the expected result. Choose cases that exercise different rules.

blocks.code:
const isFree = age => age < 5;
console.log(isFree(3), isFree(8));
blocks.title: Choose useful cases

blocks.text: The output is true false. The examples cover both sides of the age rule.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not test only many inputs that all take the same path.
For more detail later, use this [Software Testing further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Testing).
